# Brush core 0.5.0

The source is from the published `brush-core` 0.5.0 crate. Its archive SHA-256 is
`967a82f3b1bf090db686d5fb86424b19725073828532a42f960d5a13bff14ecb`.
The local change in [`src/history.rs`](src/history.rs) requests mode `0600` at
creation for Unix history files. The manifest records the WASM feature-only
dependencies for `cargo machete`. Two doc comments in `src/env.rs` and
`src/options.rs` have their trailing spaces removed. The [MIT license](LICENSE)
comes from the crate.
